note: The thirteen Designer profiles, converted from the design system without changing a word. fields.title: We make spaces that balance beauty, structure,
fields.body: One team from the first sketch to the final styling. Tell us what you are dreaming up and we will take it from there.

fields.title: Our work,
fields.kicker: Three recent projects, and what it took to get each one right.

fields.title: How we bring your vision
fields.s1b: We ask how you want to feel in the space before we draw a line. The plan follows from there.
fields.s2l: Because a drawing is only a wish until it is built.
fields.s2b: We know permits, inspectors and trades, so the design you approve is the one that gets made.
fields.s3b: The people who plan your project see it through, and you always know who to call.

fields.title: Ways to

fields.title: Learn to plan

fields.kicker: Open evenings, small workshops and tours of finished projects.

fields.title: Stay close

fields.title: Led by vision.
fields.lead: Your name pairs a designer’s eye with a builder’s discipline.
fields.body:
Ten years inside every phase of a project, from structural planning to the last cushion, means the results feel cohesive and the process feels calm.
The studio exists to be the kind of firm we always wished we could hire: a clear vision, steady communication and an experience as considered as the outcome.
fields.quote: Design without follow-through is only a wish.

fields.title: Bring your vision
fields.c1b: Where does everyone gather? What do you notice first when you walk in?
fields.c2a: One careful choice at a time.
fields.c2b: You are involved in what matters without carrying the weight of it all.
fields.c3a: A space that feels like yours.
fields.c3b: It is the whole experience, not only the outcome, and it starts with a conversation.

fields.title: Plan with
fields.kicker: Free guides and checklists from the studio. Read them before you call anyone, including us.

fields.title: A letter each season.
fields.body: What we are sourcing, what we are building and the dates of the next open studio.

projects.title: Porch House
projects.summary: A new family home planned around a deep cedar porch: white board and batten, black steel windows and a walk lined in lavender.

projects.title: Walnut Island Kitchen
projects.summary: A closed kitchen opened into one long room: a walnut island for four, a marble backsplash and black-framed windows onto the trees.

projects.title: The Gallery House
projects.summary: A double-height living space rebuilt around one long island, warm oak floors and a dining room that opens to the garden.

projects.title: Quiet Bedroom Suite
projects.summary: A main suite and family room reworked in soft white, charcoal linen and walnut, with the windows left to do the talking.

faqs.q: How early should we bring you in?
faqs.a: As early as you like, even before you have plans. A first conversation costs nothing and saves the most money.

faqs.q: Do we need an architect or plans first?
faqs.a: No. Many clients come to us with only an idea. We handle design, drawings and permits in-house.

faqs.q: How involved will we need to be?
faqs.a: As much as you want. You approve every decision that matters, and we carry the rest.
It depends on scope, size and finish level. After the consultation you get a written range, and a fixed proposal before anything starts.

hero.title: Rooms that feel like
hero.body: Layout, colour, furniture and the last styled shelf. We plan every room around how you actually live in it.

offerings.title: Ways to
offerings.kicker: Start with one room or plan the whole home. Every project begins with a free call.

faqs: Can you work with furniture we already own?
Yes. We start with what you love and plan around it, then fill the gaps.
Do you only do whole homes?
No. Plenty of projects are one room. A consultation is a good place to start.
How do you charge?
A fixed design fee per room or project, agreed before we start. Furniture is billed at our trade price.

hero.title: A house drawn around
hero.body: New homes, additions and careful renovations. We draw, we permit and we stay on site until it is built right.

steps.title: From first sketch
steps.s1b: We walk the site, learn how you live and agree a brief and a budget range.
steps.s2b: Concept, drawings and approvals, with a clear decision at every stage.
steps.s3b: We stay through construction so the house matches the drawings.

gatherings.title: Come to
gatherings.kicker: Evening talks on houses, planning and building well.

faqs: How long does a new home take?
Design and permits usually take six to nine months; building takes twelve to eighteen. We give you a schedule at the start.
Do you work outside the city?
Yes, within about two hours. Further away, ask and we will say honestly whether we are the right fit.
